description: This Java class 'RatingStatistics' computes statistics related to book ratings in a book-tracking application. It includes methods to find the most liked and least liked books, as well as to calculate the average rating for read books.

classes.name: RatingStatistics
classes.description: Class providing statistical analysis of book ratings, including finding most liked, least liked books and calculating average ratings.

methods.name: findMostLikedBook
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the book with the highest rating from the read books, or empty if not applicable.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBook
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the book with the lowest rating from the read books, or empty if not applicable.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGiven
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average rating of books in the 'read' shelf, or empty if not enough data.

methods.name: findReadBooksWithRatings
methods.description: Private helper method to filter read books that have a rating assigned.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Private helper method to sum the ratings of read books.
